errors.journal_entry_already_reversed.en: This entry has already been reversed with a correcting entry.

errors.period_unlock_reason_required.note: FR-GL-007. api.ledger.periods.PeriodService.unlock requires a stated reason - it is recorded in the audit log and is what the unlock authority is answerable for.
errors.period_unlock_reason_required.nl: Geef een reden op om deze periode te heropenen.
errors.period_unlock_reason_required.en: Give a reason for reopening this period.

errors.asset_not_found.note: Answers 'no such asset' and 'not yours' identically - the same RLS posture errors.customer_not_found takes.
errors.asset_not_found.en: That fixed asset does not exist.

errors.asset_field_invalid.note: api.assets.model.InvalidAssetField, covering every field-level refusal on the Assets screen (name, dates, accounts, amounts). {field} travels beside the sentence as a machine field, never inside it - the same convention errors.customer_field_invalid uses.
errors.asset_field_invalid.nl: Dit gegeven klopt niet. Controleer het gemarkeerde veld.
errors.asset_field_invalid.en: That value is not valid. Check the highlighted field.

errors.asset_already_disposed.note: A disposed asset's cost and accumulated depreciation are already cleared; there is nothing left to depreciate or dispose of a second time.
errors.asset_already_disposed.en: This asset has already been disposed of.

errors.asset_depreciation_already_posted.note: 0064's fixed_asset_depreciation_run_once_idx: a second attempt at the same asset's same period would double the expense.
errors.asset_depreciation_already_posted.nl: Voor deze periode is al een afschrijving geboekt voor dit activum.
errors.asset_depreciation_already_posted.en: A depreciation charge has already been posted for this asset in this period.

errors.asset_fully_depreciated.nl: Dit activum is al volledig afgeschreven; er is niets meer om te boeken.
errors.asset_fully_depreciated.en: This asset is already fully depreciated; there is nothing left to post.

errors.bank_account_not_found.note: Answers 'no such bank account' and 'not yours' identically - the same RLS posture errors.customer_not_found takes.
errors.bank_account_not_found.en: That bank account does not exist.

errors.bank_transaction_not_found.en: That bank transaction does not exist.

errors.bank_transaction_already_reconcil.en: This bank transaction has already been reconciled.

errors.bank_no_active_journal.note: FR-GL-002. No single active bank journal, or several - both mean there is no journal this reconciliation obviously belongs in.
errors.bank_no_active_journal.nl: Deze administratie heeft geen (of meer dan een) actief bankdagboek. Stel er precies een in.
errors.bank_no_active_journal.en: This administration has no single active bank journal. Set up exactly one.

errors.bank_field_invalid.note: api.bank.model.InvalidBankField, covering every field-level refusal on the Bank screen. {field} travels beside the sentence as a machine field, never inside it.
errors.bank_field_invalid.nl: Dit gegeven klopt niet. Controleer het gemarkeerde veld.
errors.bank_field_invalid.en: That value is not valid. Check the highlighted field.

errors.bank_statement_invalid.note: api.bank.csv_parser.CsvStatementError: a missing required column, or a row whose date/amount could not be parsed. {detail} is the parser's own already-specific English reason, for a log rather than the sentence (FR-UX-007).
errors.bank_statement_invalid.nl: Dit bestand kan niet worden geimporteerd. Controleer of het de kolommen date, amount, counterparty_name, counterparty_iban en description heeft.
errors.bank_statement_invalid.en: This file could not be imported. Check that it has the columns date, amount, counterparty_name, counterparty_iban and description.

errors.vat_period_not_found.note: ADR-087. The period in the path is not this administration's, or does not exist - indistinguishable on purpose.
errors.vat_period_not_found.en: This return period does not exist.

errors.vat_box_unknown.note: ADR-087. A drill-down for a rubriek that is not on the OB-aangifte.
errors.vat_box_unknown.nl: Rubriek {code} staat niet op de btw-aangifte.
errors.vat_box_unknown.en: Box {code} is not on the BTW return.

errors.vat_return_already_filed.note: ADR-087. Filing a period twice. A correction to a filed return is a suppletie, so the sentence says so.
errors.vat_return_already_filed.nl: De aangifte over deze periode is al ingediend. Een correctie gaat via een suppletie of via de aangifte van de volgende periode.
errors.vat_return_already_filed.en: The return for this period has already been filed. A correction goes through a suppletie or the next period's return.

errors.vat_return_not_fileable.note: ADR-087 / FR-VAT-002. A blocking check fired; `checks` carries their codes and the screen names each one.
errors.vat_return_not_fileable.nl: Deze aangifte kan nog niet worden ingediend. Los eerst de blokkerende punten op.
errors.vat_return_not_fileable.en: This return cannot be filed yet. Resolve the blocking items first.

errors.vat_warnings_not_acknowledged.note: ADR-087 / FR-VAT-002. A warning the filer has not ticked; `checks` carries which.
errors.vat_warnings_not_acknowledged.nl: Bevestig eerst dat u de waarschuwingen heeft gezien.
errors.vat_warnings_not_acknowledged.en: Confirm that you have seen the warnings first.

errors.vat_figures_changed.note: ADR-087. Something was posted into the period between review and filing, so the figures on screen are no longer the ledger's.
errors.vat_figures_changed.nl: De bedragen zijn veranderd sinds u de aangifte bekeek. Controleer de aangifte opnieuw en dien haar dan in.
errors.vat_figures_changed.en: The figures changed since you reviewed the return. Check it again, then file.

errors.vat_expected_total_invalid.note: ADR-087. expected_total was not a decimal string.
errors.vat_expected_total_invalid.nl: Het gecontroleerde totaal is geen geldig bedrag.
errors.vat_expected_total_invalid.en: The reviewed total is not a valid amount.

errors.vat_filing_reference_invalid.note: ADR-087. The Belastingdienst reference is longer than any reference they issue.
errors.vat_filing_reference_invalid.nl: Het kenmerk van de Belastingdienst is te lang.
errors.vat_filing_reference_invalid.en: The Belastingdienst reference is too long.

errors.opening_already_posted.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_already_posted.nl: Het boekjaar heeft al een beginbalans. Wilt u die wijzigen, boek hem dan terug in het memoriaal en voer hem opnieuw in.
errors.opening_already_posted.en: This fiscal year already has an opening balance. To change it, reverse it in the journal and enter it again.

errors.opening_amount_invalid.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_amount_invalid.nl: Een bedrag in de beginbalans is ongeldig. Gebruik positieve bedragen met hoogstens twee decimalen.
errors.opening_amount_invalid.en: An amount in the opening balance is not valid. Use positive amounts with at most two decimals.

errors.opening_account_unknown.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_account_unknown.nl: Een rekening in de beginbalans hoort niet bij deze administratie.
errors.opening_account_unknown.en: An account in the opening balance does not belong to this administration.

errors.opening_both_sides.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_both_sides.nl: Rekening {code} heeft zowel een debet- als een creditbedrag. Vul er één in.
errors.opening_both_sides.en: Account {code} has both a debit and a credit amount. Enter one.

errors.opening_not_balance_sheet.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_not_balance_sheet.nl: Rekening {code} is een resultaatrekening. Een beginbalans bevat alleen balansrekeningen.
errors.opening_not_balance_sheet.en: Account {code} is a profit-and-loss account. An opening balance holds balance-sheet accounts only.

errors.opening_control_account.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_control_account.nl: Rekening {code} is een debiteuren- of crediteurenrekening. Openstaande posten voert u in als facturen, niet als beginbalans.
errors.opening_control_account.en: Account {code} is a receivables or payables account. Open items are entered as invoices, not in the opening balance.

errors.opening_account_blocked.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.

errors.opening_duplicate_account.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_duplicate_account.nl: Rekening {code} staat twee keer in de beginbalans.
errors.opening_duplicate_account.en: Account {code} appears twice in the opening balance.

errors.opening_empty.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_empty.en: The opening balance has no amounts.

errors.opening_not_balanced.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_not_balanced.nl: De beginbalans is niet in evenwicht (verschil {difference}). Kies een eigenvermogensrekening voor het verschil of pas de bedragen aan.
errors.opening_not_balanced.en: The opening balance does not balance (difference {difference}). Choose an equity account for the difference or correct the amounts.

errors.opening_balance_account_invalid.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_balance_account_invalid.nl: Het verschil kan alleen naar een actieve eigenvermogensrekening die niet al in de beginbalans staat.
errors.opening_balance_account_invalid.en: The difference can only go to an active equity account that is not already in the opening balance.

errors.opening_period_closed.note: ADR-088, the opening balance. {code} is the account's code where the problem is one account.
errors.opening_period_closed.nl: De eerste periode van dit boekjaar is afgesloten, dus er kan geen beginbalans meer in.
errors.opening_period_closed.en: The first period of this fiscal year is closed, so no opening balance can be posted into it.
